title: Authoring automation bridge (window.__flashTest) + Playwright e2e suite
description: Layer 2 of docs/18-verification-and-automation.md. (1) Dev/test-only window.__flashTest bridge installed by Shell (import.meta.env.DEV or VITE_FLASH_TEST=1) with read surface getDocument()/getSelection()/getEditContext()/getViewState()/getHistoryDepth() and act surface selectTool/setColors/stageGesture (synthesizes real PointerEvents on the stage canvas, converting STAGE coords to screen via live zoom/pan)/menu(path)/timeline(cmd)/publish() returning bytes/screenshotStage(). HARD RULE: the bridge calls only the same code paths the UI calls — real events and real command handlers, never direct model mutation, or it stops testing the UI. (2) FileIO seam: put @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog//plugin-fs behind an interface with an in-memory test implementation so e2e runs against browser-mode Vite with no Tauri runtime. (3) apps/desktop/e2e/ Playwright suite covering the 8 canonical flows in docs/18 Layer 2: per-tool draw asserts document shape; transform matrices; F5/F6/F7 + layer ops per docs/02; draw-F8-edit-in-place-place-instance per docs/07; tween create/scrub/publish; undo-redo round-trip across every mutation class; save-new-open round-trip via FileIO mock; publish then layer-1 decode + trace assertion. Wire pnpm e2e (starts Vite, runs headless). Depends on swf-verification-harness for the decode step in flow 8; coordinate with 0051 (document owner) and 0053 (symbols, in progress).
